title: Fixed Opposed Curved Leaves and Central Post Tatting Shuttle
description: One newly authored complete tatting-shuttle-inspired static handcraft tool. Two thick pointed-oval wooden leaves curve toward each other at both finite blunt tips; their real open side galleries expose one full central oval post joining them and a continuous eight-turn cream thread winding seated around that post. The lower leaf has a finite central flat resting patch. The leaves, centre post and winding together count as one whole tool, not separate assets. All numerical geometry newly authored: not the old floor-and-sidewall weaving boat with its horizontal spindle, and not an extracted bobbin from the roller lace apparatus. Four opaque PBR roles, metre scale and source Z up. Broad craft-tool category only, no copied historical or branded shuttle, bone or ivory claim, actual knot sequence, thread feed, flex, hand fit, lace output, manufacture or safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.
